ac.title: Test Tab with Configuration Interface
ac.description: Model selector dropdown, user message textarea, temperature slider (0.0-1.0, default 0.7), max tokens input (1-4000, default 500), Run Test button enabled when user message not empty

ac.title: Run Test with Loading State
ac.description: POST /api/v1/llm/test with system_prompt, user_message, model, temperature, max_tokens. Loading state with spinner and "Testing prompt..." message. Re-enable button on completion

ac.title: Result Panel with LLM Response
ac.description: Display markdown-formatted LLM response with syntax highlighting, token usage (input/output/total), execution time, cost estimate USD, Copy Response button

ac.title: Test History (Session Storage)
ac.description: Store last 5 test runs in sessionStorage (not persisted). Show timestamp (relative), model, user message preview (50 chars), result preview (100 chars), View button to load previous result

ac.title: Side-by-Side Comparison
ac.description: Select 2 tests from history, view side-by-side with split panel showing model, temperature, user message, response, tokens, cost. Highlight differences

ac.title: Error Handling
ac.description: Handle Network Error, API Error (500), Timeout, Rate Limit (429), Invalid Model. Display error type, message, details, Retry button. Preserve form state on error

ac.title: Variable Substitution Preview
ac.description: Detect {{variable}} patterns in system prompt. Show variable substitution section with input fields for sample values. Substitute before sending to LLM. Display "Variables Used" list in result

ac.title: Integration with Prompts Page
ac.description: Add "Test" as 4th tab in Prompts page (Editor | Preview | Version History | Test). Update URL to ?tab=test. Preserve editor content when switching tabs. RBAC: developer/admin only

ac.title: Responsive Layout
ac.description: Desktop (≥1024px): 2-column grid (config left, result right). Tablet (768-1023px): Stacked layout. Mobile (<768px): Vertical stack, smaller fonts, simplified controls

ac.title: Keyboard Accessibility
ac.description: Tab navigation between fields, Enter to submit, Space for checkboxes, Arrow keys for slider, Ctrl+K to copy. ARIA labels on all fields, screen reader announces status, focus indicators

constraints.constraint: Use existing UI library: shadcn/ui + Headless UI (Dialog, Slider, TabGroup)
RBAC enforcement: Test tab accessible only to developer and admin roles (check at page level)
React Query for LLM test mutation: mutation hook pattern with onSuccess, onError callbacks
React Hook Form for form state: model selector, user message, temperature, max tokens validation
Responsive design: Tailwind breakpoints md:768px, lg:1024px. Mobile-first approach
Accessibility: ARIA labels on all form fields, keyboard navigation (Tab, Enter, Arrow keys), screen reader compatible
TypeScript strict mode: All new files must use strict TypeScript with proper types
Unit test coverage: 80%+ coverage target. Test hooks (useLLMTest, useTestHistory), components (PromptTestTab, TestResultPanel), utilities (variable substitution)
Follow Next.js 14 App Router conventions: Server components where possible, client components with 'use client' directive
Tailwind CSS for styling: Use existing design tokens, responsive utilities, focus: classes for accessibility
Error handling with toast notifications: Use existing toast library (sonner) for success/error feedback
Session storage for ephemeral data: Test history stored in sessionStorage (max 5 runs, FIFO queue), not persisted to database
Variable detection pattern: Reuse regex /{{([^}]+)}}/g from Story 27 for consistent variable handling
Tab integration pattern: Follow Story 28 pattern - Headless UI TabGroup, URL query param ?tab=test, state preservation

interface.name: GET /api/v1/llm/models
interface.signature: GET /api/v1/llm/models → Array<{ id: string, name: string, provider: string, pricing: { input: number, output: number } }>
interface.notes: List available LLM models with pricing info for cost calculation

interface.name: POST /api/v1/llm/test
interface.signature: POST /api/v1/llm/test { system_prompt, user_message, model, temperature, max_tokens } → { response, usage: { input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens }, execution_time, cost, model }
interface.notes: Test prompt with LLM. Backend must use LiteLLM for multi-model support. RBAC: developer/admin roles only. Ephemeral (not persisted)

interface.name: useLLMTest()
interface.signature: useLLMTest() → { mutate: (params: LLMTestParams) => void, isPending: boolean, data: LLMTestResponse, error: Error }
interface.notes: Mutation hook for LLM test. Follow usePrompts pattern. Timeout 60s, retry 3 attempts

interface.name: useTestHistory()
interface.signature: useTestHistory() → { history: TestRun[], addTest: (test: TestRun) => void, clearHistory: () => void }
interface.notes: Session storage management. Max 5 runs (FIFO). Handle quota exceeded error

interface.name: useLLMModels()
interface.signature: useLLMModels() → { data: Model[], isLoading: boolean, error: Error }
interface.notes: Fetch available models. Cache for 5 minutes (staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000)

interface.name: PromptTestTab
interface.signature: PromptTestTab({ promptId, currentPromptContent }: { promptId: string, currentPromptContent: string }) → JSX.Element
interface.notes: Main test tab component. Receives current prompt content from parent page. Manages test configuration, result display, history

tests.standards: Test Framework: Jest + React Testing Library for unit/component tests. Playwright for E2E tests. Coverage Target: 80%+ for new components. Test Files Location: __tests__/ directory mirroring source structure (__tests__/components/prompts/, __tests__/lib/hooks/). Naming Convention: ComponentName.test.tsx for unit, feature-name.spec.ts for E2E. All tests must use TypeScript with proper types. Mock API calls with React Query testing utilities. Test accessibility with @testing-library/jest-dom matchers (toHaveAttribute, toBeInTheDocument).

ideas.idea: Test PromptTestTab renders with model selector, user message input, temperature slider, max tokens field, Run Test button. Verify button disabled when user message empty
Test useLLMTest mutation hook: success case (returns response, usage, cost), loading state (isPending true), error handling (network, API error, timeout)
Test TestResultPanel displays markdown response with syntax highlighting, token usage breakdown, execution time, cost estimate, Copy Response button. Test copy to clipboard functionality
Test useTestHistory hook: adds test run, maintains max 5 runs (FIFO), retrieves history from sessionStorage, handles quota exceeded error
Test TestComparisonView: select 2 tests, display side-by-side, highlight differences (color-coded), close comparison
Test TestErrorPanel: displays network error, API error (500), timeout, rate limit (429), invalid model. Test Retry button triggers mutation again with same params
Test variable detection regex /{{([^}]+)}}/g, variable input fields generation, substitution before API call, "Variables Used" list in result
Test tab integration: Add Test tab to page.tsx, URL updates to ?tab=test, editor content preserved when switching tabs, RBAC redirect non-developer/admin
Test responsive layout: Desktop 2-column grid (1024px+), Tablet stacked (768-1023px), Mobile vertical (< 768px). Test with Playwright at exact breakpoints
Test keyboard accessibility: Tab navigation, Enter submits, Arrow keys for slider, Ctrl+K copies response. Test ARIA labels with @testing-library/jest-dom

Test with no variables in prompt, 10+ variables, very long user message (10K chars), very long LLM response (truncation), session storage across refresh, comparison with identical tests, temperature edge values (0.0, 1.0), max tokens edge (1, 4000)

Full workflow E2E test: Navigate to Prompts → Select prompt → Click Test tab → Configure test (model, message, temp, tokens) → Run test → View result → View history → Compare 2 tests → Copy response → Switch tabs (state preserved)
